title: NemotronNormalizer (Korea-row → PersonaRecord, locale-agnostic raw catch-all)
acceptance: packages/personas/src/normalizers/nemotron.ts exports normalizeNemotronRow(row: Record<string, unknown>, ctx: { dataset, datasetRevision?, license? }): PersonaRecord
Maps every first-class column on PersonaRecord (locale.*, demographics.*, narratives.*) when present in the source row
Korea-specific columns (`military_status`, `bachelors_field`) and any unknown future column flow into narratives.raw without dropping
Builds an embeddingText body per docs/03 §Embedding text builder
Provenance fields (provider='nvidia', dataset, datasetRevision, rowId, license) preserved verbatim
Tests: a hand-built fixture mimicking a Korea row maps correctly; a synthetic row with unknown columns lands them under raw; a row missing optional columns parses without error
